reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and routes all four existing callers (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) through it.

duplication.why: Weekend-or-holiday is defined once in isWeekendOrHoliday and reused by both the resolver and the window helper; the fixed shift constant is replaced, not copied.

placement.why: Date-resolution logic stays in shared/schedules.ts; server code only forwards config.holidays, and the type gains the optional field.

scope.why: Touches only the resolver, its callers, the recur parser, the type and tests.

maintainability.why: Clean generalisation with a well-commented window helper; small residual cost is that every caller must remember to forward holidays alongside the solve mode and frequency, and the fixed WEEKEND_LOOKAHEAD was not revisited.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend-adjust call site goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the predicate is shared by the resolver and the window computation.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday / getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts (upcoming dates and getDatesInRange) and budget/schedule-template.ts.
